<!-- Generated by docs-site/scripts/generate_reference.py from plugins/airgap-anything/skills/airgap-transfer/SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->
`airgap-transfer` reads `docs/airgap/transfer-manifest.json`, which `airgap-architect` writes, and builds a bundle that checks itself. [Carrying it in](/guides/carrying-it-in/) walks through one transfer.

## Steps

| # | Step | What you do | Read |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Inputs | Run `plan.py` once. Exit 2 naming airgap-architect: stop and send the user there | |
| 2 | Questions | Fill `answers` in `docs/airgap/transfer.json`, one question per message, only those `plan.py` lists | [questions](/reference/transfer/questions/) |
| 3 | Plan | Run `plan.py` until it exits 0; it writes `plan` and `<bundle>/fetch.sh` | [channels](/reference/transfer/channels/) |
| 4 | Approval | Send the plan message of [fetch](/reference/transfer/fetch/) and end your turn. Stop until the user approves | [fetch](/reference/transfer/fetch/) |
| 5 | Fetch | The user runs `sh <bundle>/fetch.sh`, or you run it after approval. Exit 1: show the `FAILED` lines of `fetch.log`, fix, run it again | [fetch](/reference/transfer/fetch/) |
| 6 | Manual items | For every manual item: the user adds files under `<bundle>/manual/`, or marks it not needed with a reason | [questions](/reference/transfer/questions/) |
| 7 | Pack | Run `pack.py`. When the blueprint's `language` is not `en`: translate the prose of `INSIDE.md` and `AGENTS-INSIDE.md`, keep every command line, file name and key exactly as written, then run `pack.py --refresh-sums` | [bundle-layout](/reference/transfer/bundle-layout/), [inside](/reference/transfer/inside/) |
| 8 | Check | Run `check.py`; fix and repeat until it exits 0. It reports B7 for a command line that went missing in a translation, B2 for a translation whose hash was not recorded | [bundle-layout](/reference/transfer/bundle-layout/) |
| 9 | Volumes | `pack.py --write-volume N --to <folder>` for each volume, one medium at a time | [channels](/reference/transfer/channels/) |
| 10 | Hand-off | Say what to carry, what the inside does first, and what is still manual | [inside](/reference/transfer/inside/) |

## Exit codes

| Exit code | Meaning | What you do |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Done | Continue |
| 1 | `check.py` found errors (B1 to B8), or a volume did not read back | Fix each one and run it again |
| 2 | A file is missing or stale, an answer is missing or invalid, or the bundle cannot be packed yet | Do what the message says: another skill's step, a question, a fetch, a manual item |
| 3 | A tool is missing, or Python is older than 3.11 | Tell the user which tool and what needs it |
